name: Jaeger pilot ground motion helpers
description: Five helper clips, separate from the sixteen original clips. PilotWalk sampled in six PBR views. Runtime blends and contact IK still require destination validation.
brief: Preserve the complete original Jaeger geometry and add Kiln-authored activation, continuous walk, turn footwork and stop helpers.
